Section: ABOUT US > 1. Company Overview

Tecsack Software is a technology consulting and software engineering company that builds digital
solutions across a range of industries. By combining deep domain expertise with advanced technical
capabilities, the organization helps clients modernize their core systems, optimize operational workflows,
and achieve sustainable growth.

Section: ABOUT US > 1. Company Overview > 1.2 Delivery Model

● Global Delivery Capabilities:Operates through multipledelivery centers and distributed

development teams, enabling Tecsack to support clients across different geographic regions and

business environments.

● Strategic Time-Zone Coverage:Delivery teams are positionedstrategically to provide broader

time-zone coverage, allowing development, support, and communication activities to continue

efficiently across different working hours.

● Agile & Iterative Development:Follows agile and iterative development practices, allowing

projects to be delivered in manageable stages while incorporating continuous feedback,

requirement changes, testing, and improvements throughout the development lifecycle.

● Dedicated Development Teams:Builds project-specificteams consisting of developers, technical

resources, project coordinators, and other specialists based on the complexity and requirements of

each engagement.

● Flexible Engagement Models:Adapts its delivery approachaccording to project requirements,

supporting dedicated development, project-based development, product engineering, application

modernization, and ongoing maintenance and enhancement engagements.

● Business Continuity & Responsiveness:The distributeddelivery structure helps maintain

operational continuity, improve response times, and provide clients with consistent technical

support while projects progress across different working schedules.

Section: ABOUT US > 2. Mission, Vision, Values & Global Presence > 2.1 Mission

Tecsack Software is dedicated to empowering enterprises through purposeful digital transformation. By
uniting modern engineering practices with strategic advisory, the company enables organizations to
streamline operations, accelerate decision-making, and unlock new avenues for sustainable growth.

Section: ABOUT US > 2. Mission, Vision, Values & Global Presence > 2.2 Vision

Tecsack aspires to set the global standard for digital excellence. Through data-driven insights and
adaptive technology frameworks, the organization aims to continuously elevate client capabilities and
shape resilient digital ecosystems for the future.

Section: ABOUT US > 2. Mission, Vision, Values & Global Presence > 2.3 Values

Uncompromising quality, transparency, and client-centric collaboration form the foundation of every
Tecsack engagement. By adhering to rigorous ethical standards and engineering rigor, the firm builds
lasting partnerships grounded in trust and measurable value.

Section: ABOUT US > 2. Mission, Vision, Values & Global Presence > 2.4 Global Presence

Operating across strategically located global delivery centers, Tecsack seamlessly pairs deep local
domain expertise with international execution capabilities. This distributed footprint ensures continuous

operational coverage, rapid responsiveness, and consistent delivery standards for enterprise clients
worldwide.

Section: ABOUT US > 4. Leadership Team

Our leadership team brings extensive industry expertise, technical vision, and a strong commitment to
delivering exceptional business outcomes for our clients globally.

Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Sakthivel

Provides overall strategic leadership and drives the company's business direction, growth initiatives, and
long-term vision.

Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – Sowmiya

Leads the company's technical direction and plays a key role in defining architecture, engineering
practices, technology adoption, and product innovation.

Team Lead - Mugeshkumar

Coordinates development activities and supports the team in maintaining efficient project execution,
technical quality, and consistent delivery standards.

Software Developers – Manoj & Manivanan

The software development team is responsible for the hands-on engineering and implementation of client
applications and internal software solutions.
